description: This file is a C++ source code implementing a test application for graphics buffer handling, including server and client buffer classes, buffer creation, monitoring, and a command-line interface for interaction.

classes.name: ServerBuffer
classes.description: A server-side graphics buffer class managing buffer creation, monitoring, and request handling.

classes.name: ClientBuffer
classes.description: A client-side graphics buffer class that loads descriptors and monitors buffer state.

classes.name: Dispatcher
classes.description: Handles requests and offers for buffer management, acting as a communication facilitator.

classes.name: Callback
classes.description: Inner class of Dispatcher, implements callback interface for request handling.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new ServerBuffer instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: Find
methods.description: Finds an existing ServerBuffer by callsign.

methods.name: Rendered
methods.description: Indicates the buffer has been rendered.

methods.name: Published
methods.description: Indicates the buffer has been published.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a buffer to the Dispatcher with an associated ID.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a buffer from the Dispatcher by ID.

methods.name: Request
methods.description: Performs a request for buffer descriptors via the Dispatcher.
